PostToolUse.description: After Claude edits a Python file (scoped to that file), mirror the pre-commit ruff steps: auto-sort imports, format, then report any remaining lint issues back to Claude (exit 2) so they get fixed in-context. Only imports are auto-fixed; other rules are surfaced, not silently rewritten — matching the pre-commit policy.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) uv run ruff check --select I --fix --force-exclude "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ; uv run ruff format --force-exclude "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ; uv run ruff check --force-exclude "$f" 1>&2 || exit 2 ;; esac
